detail: The PIPELINE HALF of this law's consequence paragraph is fixed as of commit 3a1020a9a; the ALIGNMENT half is confirmed and now measured image-wide. BEFORE: `datadiff.py --matching --no-deadstrip` printed 53 MISMATCH rows and exited 1, and every one of the 53 was a zero-filled claim-slack row -- zero rows carried a differing byte, a NONZERO tail or an over-claim. Those 53 rows sit on 44 units that are ALREADY Object(Matching) and already link green, so finish_tu's refusal ('data bytes differ from DOL ... wrong constants or emission order never link green') was provably false for the whole class. AFTER: the same command exits 0, prints each row as DATA-DEBT, and ends with a summary: 53 zero-filled claim-slack sections over 44 units, 258 bytes. datadiff exits 1 only on a real defect now (a differing non-relocated word, a NONZERO slack tail, an object larger than its claim); `--strict-slack` restores the old refusing behaviour, and tools/gdl/tests/test_t16_slack_gate.py pins both sides (4 shapes that must not block, 4 that must). NEW MEASUREMENT OF THE ALIGNMENT HALF: each row is classified by whether the parent law's shrink fix is REACHABLE -- the object's true extent address is 4-byte aligned, or another unit already claims the range so dtk generates no auto split. Of the 53: 21 shrinkable, 32 structural. Every one of the 21 shrinkable ends is 4-aligned; the claimed-neighbour clause (the mb_font counterexample this law cites) contributed ZERO rows at this commit, so it is currently a theoretical escape rather than an observed one. SEPARATE FINDING, which qualifies the PARENT law rather than this one: claim.law.splits-claim-can-swallow-link-alignment-padding.20260901.v1 states that such an over-claim zeroes the whole section's matched_data credit. That is not universal at this commit -- 20 of the 44 units carrying a zero-slack row read matched_data_percent 100.0 in build/GUNE5D/report.json (game/ui/message.c has a 0x7 slack row and scores 7336/7336), while 24 read below 100. The mb_font fix that motivated the parent law shrank symbols.txt's owning symbol SIZE as well as the splits end, which is the difference the parent law's blanket phrasing does not carry.
locator: python tools/gdl/datadiff.py --matching --no-deadstrip  (at c621fcbac and again at 3a1020a9a); python tools/gdl/finish_tu.py
